in_hebrew.name: Kaida
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Kaida הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Kaida is of unknown origin, but it can be translated to 'strong one'. In Christian traditions, it may be associated with the biblical figure Kaida, a warrior mentioned in the Book of Revelation. The name carries a sense of strength, courage, and determination.
